name: 48858 · Mt Pleasant, MI
findings: ZIP 48858 (Mt Pleasant) has 168 nonprofit organizations. 84 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 66 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48858 (Mt Pleasant) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
51% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: 6 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
